answer: Resist Sybils with tidal echo-sounding: every identity moors one grove-anchor in the shared ocean, staking attestations across epochs. Each epoch a random verifier sweeps the grove with ripple pings; honest anchors return deep echoes carrying their witnessed work history. Sybil fleets return shallow identical echoes - ten anchors echoing the same ping - and echo-depth triangulation fuses them into one stake, collapsing the fleet. Shallow anchors lose mooring rights while deep-echo anchors gain attestation weight. Clones cannot buy depth; only witnessed honest epochs deepen an echo.
